name: Telegram Voice Language Translator
description: Transcribe a Telegram voice message, translate between two configured languages and reply to the same chat with both text and complete synthesized audio.
requirements: One Telegram bot Connection shared by trigger, get_me, getFile Proxy and text reply; only one active webhook per bot
A secret TELEGRAM_AUDIO_BOT_TOKEN Variable separately configured with that same bot token for missing download/multipart APIs
Telegram Proxy permission for getFile and exact api.telegram.org HTTP capability on three Code steps
OpenAI connection for whisper-1 transcription and tts-1/alloy MP3 speech; gpt-5-mini Agent route
Input/output bytes must fit the deployment’s normal 1MiB fetch/Code budgets; no silent truncation; inspect uncertain sends before replay

source.path: Telegram/Translate Telegram audio messages with AI (55 supported languages).json
